title: The Good, The Bad, And The Godly

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Stop it, Geets! This isn't like you! You're not a bad guy!

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: When on this worthless Earth did I ever become a quote-unquote good guy?

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: You were at Krillin's barbecue last week!

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: Yeah, and I brought potato salad.

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: He is truly lost to us.

lines.speaker: Supreme Kai
lines.text: This fight will only serve to hasten Majin Buu's awakening!

lines.speaker: Supreme Kai
lines.text: Much stronger than any of you!

lines.speaker: Supreme Kai
lines.text: No, I mean he can literally blow up galaxies!

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: Mr. Shin, you are only making this worse.
